summary.text: Virginia McLean is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Robert Harris.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community leader and educator who serves as Director of Religious Education at the Unitarian Universalist Church of Spartanburg.

paragraphs.text: Virginia McLean earned a high school diploma from Irmo High School, a bachelor's degree from Winthrop University in 2004 and a graduate degree from the Lutheran Theological Seminary at Philadelphia in 2008.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as minister.

In her survey, McLean said she grew up as an "Army brat," has spent her career focused on the well-being of children, youth and families, and is a co-founder of the Spartanburg Creative Reuse Art Project, a non-profit promoting environmental awareness through art.
She said she lives in Lyman with her husband and two sons.

McLean said in the survey that her top priority is public education, from preschool through high school graduation, and that she wants a long-term plan for roads and schools as Spartanburg County grows.
She also named equality and civil rights, and environmental protection, as policy areas she cares about.
